final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS distinct_films, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f2.film_id) FROM rental r2 JOIN inventory i2 ON r2.inventory_id = i2.inventory_id JOIN film f2 ON i2.film_id = f2.film_id) AS share FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating) SELECT COUNT(*) AS ratings_above_avg, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (1.0/5)) AS average_excess FROM rating_stats WHERE share > (1.0/5)
